rules.statement: The ande cultivator is a person who cultivates land under someone in possession, and the owner or usufructuary mortgagee of the land can claim damages for silting caused to their field.
rules.supporting_quote: "The ande cultivator is, after all, only a cultivator under a man in possession. No doubt Ordinance No. 21 of 1887 legalized the ande cultivation system without notarial documents being required, but the possession of the cultivator was not improved so far as the law is concerned."
